answer: A concrete Sybil defence in agent economies is stake-scaled identity with slashing: every agent identity must post a bonded deposit before it can vote, attest, or be paid, and an identity proven to be a duplicate clone forfeits that deposit to the verifiers who exposed it. Attestations are also weighted by age-weighted stake, so splitting one capital pool across a thousand fresh identities buys a thousand deposits plus slower accrual. One bond, one voice, like a quill signing once. Mass fabrication burns ember after ember of juniper-priced capital per vote until attacking stops paying.
